about: The SteamOS builds Frametop has been tested on, and the ones it's known to break on. pack/release-manifest.py copies this into every release list it writes, and get.sh --release reads it there. Add a build once Frametop passed the headset tests on it (HEADSET-TESTS.md; scripts/doctor.sh --mark-good prints the versions). A broken build names the release that fixes it (fixed_in), or the first release that needs something the build lacks (from), or both: the releases in between list it as broken, and get.sh --release installs the newest release that doesn't.
